341-2363-4659-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Umori, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2893-3875-8336-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Amanda Grayson trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Amanda Grayson trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3668-4808-4812-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying {U}{U}, causing it to enter with vanishing 3 as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

465-6132-8095.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3234-3293-3899-6620.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-3899-6620.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-3899-6620.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-4094-6441-6664-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

3179-4399-4770-6752.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Haliya trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4770-6752.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

527-1409-7296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-1169-2043-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7233.easyPrerequisites: Instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard have total mana value 2 or greater.
2034-6972-7233.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Inferno Project.
When Inferno Project dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

620-3532-5078-6595.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-3532-5078-6595.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Lyse's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

1987-2468-2751-3139.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking The Great Henge and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

4321-4559-5686.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 11.
4321-4559-5686.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating a Blood and a Food token.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Blood and Food, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2457-3000-4094-5794.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Squirrel and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

539-2244-4803-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-2244-4803-5295.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

2615-4068-6562.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2615-4068-6562.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
2615-4068-6562.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

643-3767-3918-3941.description:
Activate Trazyn using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

372-2781-3086.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-2781-3086.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Lagrella and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Felidar Guardian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Lagrella to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Lagrella and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Lagrella and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

245-969-1069-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
245-969-1069-5499.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to an Astartes Warrior.
Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

1479-3257-4288.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3257-4288.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Sarinth Greatwurm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

443-3240-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Magus of the Bridge triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1102-1379-1636-4186.notablePrerequisites: Steel Overseer does not have summoning sickness.
1102-1379-1636-4186.description:
Activate Steel Overseer by tapping it, putting +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

132-4740.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Myr Welder lifelink.
Your life total is at least 51.
Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-4740.description:
Give Myr Welder lifelink, if needed.
Activate Myr Welder using Aetherflux Reservoir's ability by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target and causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat step 2.

750-2438-3451-4766.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value four or greater.
750-2438-3451-4766.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dutiful Attendant.
When Dutiful Attendant dies, it, Deathrender and Death's Oasis triggers.
Resolve the Dutiful Attendant trigger, returning a creature card with mana value four or greater from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature with mana value four or greater from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Death's Oasis trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return a creature card with mana value two or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Deathrender and Death's Oasis triggers.
Resolve the Death's Oasis trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Dutiful Attendant from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Dutiful Attendant from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities from steps 1 and 6, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

788-927.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, giving control of Manta Ray to an opponent who controls no Islands.
When Manta Ray's controller controls no Islands, Manta Ray triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Manta Ray cannot be sacrificed due to its ability.
Manta Ray triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

1235-4867-4871.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R}.
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, creating a token copy of Cormela.
 Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cormela dies, triggering itself and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Cormela's trigger, returning Twinflame to hand.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1860-2634-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
1860-2634-5211.description:
Activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it,  allowing you to cast spells as though they have flash this turn.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the Brass's Bounty copy, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

57-570-2059.notablePrerequisites: Feldon and Faeburrow Elder aren't summoning sickness.
57-570-2059.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder to add {W}{R}{G}.
Activate Feldon to create a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer.
The token enters, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
